papers.title: Evaluation of topology-optimized lattice structures manufactured via selective laser melting
papers.first_author_affiliation: School of Mechanical & Automotive Engineering, South China University of Technology, Guangzhou 510640, PR China

corresponding_authors.name: Yongqiang Yang
corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Mechanical & Automotive Engineering, South China University of Technology, Guangzhou 510640, PR China

corresponding_authors.name: Di Wang
corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Mechanical & Automotive Engineering, South China University of Technology, Guangzhou 510640, PR China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了拓扑优化点阵结构的SLM制造与力学性能评估，对多孔植入物设计具有参考价值，但缺乏生物医学背景和疲劳测试。
llm.why_not_core: No osseointegration or surface roughness data, no fatigue testing, and no explicit link to biomedical implant stress shielding.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估拓扑优化点阵结构的力学性能，以用于轻量化或植入物设计。
summary_zh.method: 使用SLM制造优化后的点阵结构，并进行准静态压缩测试。
summary_zh.result: 优化点阵结构在刚度与强度方面表现出优异性能。
summary_zh.validation: 实验力学测试验证了数值优化结果。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the mechanical performance of topology-optimized lattice structures for potential lightweight or implant applications.
summary_en.method: Selective laser melting was used to fabricate the optimized lattices, followed by quasi-static compression testing.
summary_en.result: Optimized lattice structures exhibited superior stiffness and strength compared to conventional designs.
summary_en.validation: Experimental mechanical testing validated the numerical optimization results.

papers.venue: Journal of the mechanical behavior of biomedical materials/Journal of mechanical behavior of biomedical materials

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文直接研究通过选择性激光熔化制备连续功能梯度多孔钛支架，用于骨植入物以降低应力遮挡，与用户关注的AM生物医学材料方向高度相关。
llm.why_not_core: It does not cover fatigue testing, surface roughness characterization, or osseointegration evaluation.

summary_zh.motivation: 设计连续功能梯度多孔支架以匹配骨刚度，减少应力遮挡
summary_zh.method: 采用选择性激光熔化制备具有连续梯度孔隙的钛合金支架
summary_zh.result: 支架的力学性能可通过孔隙结构调控，匹配人体骨
summary_zh.validation: 通过压缩力学测试验证支架的力学性能

summary_en.motivation: To design continuously graded porous scaffolds that match bone stiffness and reduce stress shielding in bone implants.
summary_en.method: Selective laser melting was used to fabricate titanium alloy scaffolds with continuous gradient porosity.
summary_en.result: The mechanical properties of the scaffolds were tailored to match those of human bone by controlling pore structure.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical compression tests were performed on fabricated scaffolds to validate their mechanical performance.

papers.title: Microstructure prediction of selective laser melting AlSi10Mg using finite element analysis
papers.first_author_affiliation: Wuhan National Laboratory for Optoelectronics, Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Wuhan, Hubei 430074, PR China

corresponding_authors.name: Haihong Zhu
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Wuhan National Laboratory for Optoelectronics, Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Wuhan, Hubei 430074, PR China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及选区激光熔化AlSi10Mg的微观结构预测，而非生物医学植入物的力学性能或骨整合，与用户研究方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on microstructure prediction of AlSi10Mg alloy, with no biomedical context, no porous implants, no mechanical testing (fatigue or static), and no surface roughness or osseointegration evaluation.

summary_zh.motivation: 采用有限元方法预测选区激光熔化AlSi10Mg的微观结构。
summary_zh.method: 建立有限元模型模拟热场和熔池动力学，预测凝固组织。
summary_zh.result: 成功预测了不同工艺参数下的微观结构特征。
summary_zh.validation: 通过与实验微观结构对比验证模型准确性。

summary_en.motivation: To predict microstructure evolution during selective laser melting of AlSi10Mg using finite element analysis.
summary_en.method: A finite element model was developed to simulate thermal field and melt pool dynamics, enabling prediction of solidification microstructure.
summary_en.result: The model successfully predicted microstructural features such as grain size and morphology under varying process parameters.
summary_en.validation: The predictions were validated by comparison with experimental microstructures obtained from selective laser melted samples.
